correctness.rationale: The monotone-data cone is represented exactly by nonnegative increments and one slack variable, so linear optimization reduces to simplex vertices and yields the cumulative-weight criterion without approximation. Exact rational replay solves the defining moment system through n=13, reproduces the published n=12 coefficients, proves the first negative cumulative weight and exact defect, verifies a strict monotone witness, and proves all n=13 cumulative weights positive.
